rationale: The bounded evidence indicates broad cross-owner, cross-host runtime and product-semantics impact: six canonical owners, eight source paths, eight derived paths, and twelve critical governance scenarios across three hosts. Deterministic propagation is absent, so neither verified_change nor a compact path is supportable. This is a non-authorizing benchmark candidate only.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR approval is visible as measurement evidence.
The lifecycle is brownfield_candidate; completed Brownfield analysis is not evidenced.
No stored quick_task context is supplied, so compact_delivery requirements are not met.
Six canonical owners and cross-host runtime impact exceed a narrow local-change boundary.
Derived paths exist while deterministic propagation is false, excluding verified_change.
Product semantics and runtime are impacted across three hosts; broader impact must fail closed.
